points.title: 出生与早年生活
points.description: 齐白石出生于湖南省湘潭县的一个农民家庭，他的早年生活主要是务农。他在这里接受了基本的启蒙教育，并开始对绘画产生兴趣。齐白石在湘潭的生活为他后来的艺术创作奠定了基础，他深受家乡的自然风光和民间艺术的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Qi Baishi was born into a farming family in Xiangtan County, Hunan Province. His early life was spent farming. He received basic education here and began to develop an interest in painting. Qi Baishi's life in his hometown laid the foundation for his later artistic creation, deeply influenced by the natural scenery and folk art of his hometown.

points.title: 艺术启蒙与早期创作
points.description: 齐白石在1880年开始学习绘画，师从当地画家学习山水画。他在这一时期创作了大量作品，包括《山水清音图》等。这一阶段，齐白石的艺术风格开始形成，他开始探索自己的艺术道路。
points.descriptionEn: In 1880, Qi Baishi began to study painting and was taught by local painters in the style of landscape painting. During this period, he created a large number of works, including 'The Sound of Clearness in Landscape'. It was during this time that Qi Baishi's artistic style began to take shape, and he started to explore his own artistic path.

points.title: 艺术发展与教学
points.description: 1900年，齐白石移居长沙市，开始了他的艺术生涯。他在这里开设了画室，教授绘画，并创作了大量作品。这一时期，齐白石的艺术风格逐渐成熟，他的作品开始受到社会的关注。他还参与了长沙的美术展览，并在此期间结识了许多艺术家。
points.descriptionEn: In 1900, Qi Baishi moved to Changsha and began his artistic career. He opened a studio here, taught painting, and created a large number of works. During this period, Qi Baishi's artistic style gradually matured, and his works began to receive social attention. He also participated in art exhibitions in Changsha and met many artists during this time.

points.title: 艺术巅峰与晚年生活
points.description: 1918年，齐白石移居北京，这是他艺术生涯的巅峰时期。他在北京创作了大量作品，包括《虾》、《蟹》等著名画作。他还被聘为北京艺术学院的教授，培养了一代又一代的艺术家。齐白石在北京的生活和创作，使他成为中国现代美术的重要代表。
points.descriptionEn: In 1918, Qi Baishi moved to Beijing, which was the peak of his artistic career. He created a large number of works in Beijing, including famous paintings such as 'Shrimp' and 'Crab'. He was also appointed as a professor at the Beijing Academy of Arts, training generations of artists. Qi Baishi's life and creation in Beijing made him an important representative of modern Chinese art.

supporter.zh: 齐白石被誉为中国现代美术的奠基人之一，他的作品具有极高的艺术价值和历史价值。他的绘画风格独特，融合了中国传统绘画的精髓和个人的创新，对中国美术的发展产生了深远的影响。
supporter.en: Qi Baishi is hailed as one of the founders of modern Chinese art, with his works holding high artistic and historical value. His painting style is unique, blending the essence of traditional Chinese painting with personal innovation, and has had a profound impact on the development of Chinese art.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为齐白石的作品过于注重形式美，忽视了内容深度。此外，他的某些作品被认为过于商业化和迎合市场。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Qi Baishi's works place too much emphasis on formal beauty and neglect content depth. Moreover, some of his works are considered too commercial and market-oriented.

objective.zh: 齐白石是中国现代美术的重要代表，他的作品不仅在中国，也在世界范围内产生了广泛的影响。他的艺术成就和贡献，使他成为中国美术史上的一个重要人物。
objective.en: Qi Baishi is an important representative of modern Chinese art, whose works have had a wide impact both in China and around the world. His artistic achievements and contributions have made him an important figure in the history of Chinese art.

self.en: Learn from me and you will live; imitate me and you will die.

others.zh: 齐白石是中国画坛的一座高峰，他的艺术成就无人能及。
others.en: Qi Baishi is a peak in the Chinese art world, and his artistic achievements are unmatched.
